MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 88

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 66
   D. 17

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

5. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 120
   C. 23
   D. 30

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 90
   D. 42

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

13. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 8

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

21. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 49

22. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 9
   D. 21

23. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

24. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
